name: superpowers-automation
description: A new-work orchestrator skill that classifies a description as feature/fix/refactor and drives the matching superpowers pipeline (feature/refactor: branch -> brainstorm -> spec review -> plan -> plan review -> implement; fix: systematic-debugging) with advisor-driven file revision at the spec and plan stages; the file-advisor-improver skill (forked Sonnet) that reviews a file via advisor() and revises it in place; and one opt-in PostToolUse:Write hook that forces Subagent-Driven implementation after a plan is written. Hook defaults off.

hook_plans.title: Plans hook
hook_plans.description: Values: true = on writing docs/superpowers/plans/*.md, inject an instruction to implement the plan with superpowers:subagent-driven-development (forcing Subagent-Driven over the writing-plans execution-choice prompt); false = no injection. Default: false.
